posts.title: How to Build a Stylish Website Without Sacrificing Usability
posts.excerpt: A thoughtful website starts with a clear purpose. Pair expressive typography and a focused color palette with strong hierarchy, responsive layouts, accessible contrast, and fast-loading pages so the design feels as good to use as it looks.
